# Flip & Mirror Video

- Route: `/tools/flip-video`
- Kind: `tool`
- Category: `video`
- Slug: `flip-video`

## Summary

Mirror a video horizontally to fix a reversed webcam or selfie, or flip it vertically, in one click. (Video tools)

## Details

Front cameras and webcams often record a mirror image: text reads backwards and your parting is on the wrong side. Mirroring the clip once puts it right. Media Manipulator flips video horizontally or vertically on our servers with FFmpeg, re-encodes so the flip is baked into the frames, and exports MP4 that plays correctly in every player.
### What it does
- Mirrors a video horizontally (left-right) or flips it vertically (top-bottom).
- Combine with 90°, 180° or 270° rotation in the same pass.
- Bakes the transform into the frames; no reliance on a rotation flag.
- Exports MP4 by default, or any supported container.
### How to use it
1. Upload a video: Any common format.
2. Pick a flip: Horizontal is preselected; add vertical or a rotation.
3. Convert: FFmpeg applies hflip/vflip and re-encodes.
4. Download: Save the corrected MP4.
### Supported formats
- Input: mp4, mov, mkv, webm, avi, m4v, flv, wmv
- Output: mp4, webm, mov, mkv
### Technical details
- Horizontal flip uses the hflip filter, vertical uses vflip; both are lossless in geometry and re-encode the frames.
- Mirroring plus a 180° rotation equals a vertical flip; the panel lets you combine them freely.
- MP4 output uses H.264 + AAC + yuv420p + faststart.
### Use cases
- Un-mirror a selfie: Make text and logos read correctly.
- Upside-down mount: Flip footage from an inverted camera.
- Mirror for a tutorial: Mirror a demonstration so viewers can copy it directly.
- Match a shot: Mirror a clip so the subject faces the other way.
### FAQ
Q: Mirror or flip, what is the difference?
A: Mirror (horizontal flip) swaps left and right. Vertical flip swaps top and bottom.
Q: Is the flip permanent?
A: Yes. The frames are re-encoded with the flip applied, so every player shows it.
Q: Can I rotate as well?
A: Yes. Rotation lives in the same Transform section, or use the dedicated Rotate video tool.
Q: Does flipping reduce quality?
A: Re-encoding has a small cost; choose high quality to keep it negligible.

## Routing

When to send a visitor here: Send visitors here when a video is mirrored, for example a reversed webcam or selfie recording, or needs a vertical flip. Flips can be combined with a rotation in the same pass.
When to send them elsewhere: If the problem is only orientation, Rotate Video (rotate-video) is the direct page. Playing a clip backwards is Reverse Video (reverse-video), not flipping.
